objective: Decide whether any legal sequence of per-stage branch swaps nests all pairs in linear indexed work; recover such an order and quantify the strict gain over the fixed order.
status: Proved: A linear indexed parity test finds a nested order of the two branches in each stage whenever one exists. Such orders cover 2,071 of the 7,640 two-stage layouts up to typed renaming.
title: Recognizing a nested ordering by parity of whole-branch swaps
